Package de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug.data.chart

Class ChartData<T extends ChartData<T>>

java.lang.Object
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug.data.chart.ChartData<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the chart class, returned by the fluent setters
Direct Known Subclasses:
AxisChart, CategoryChart, CustomChart, GaugeChart, HeatmapChart
public abstract class ChartData<T extends ChartData<T>> extends Object
A chart in a debug report.

Each chart type has its own class with the options that apply to it: SeriesChart, ScatterChart, CategoryChart, HeatmapChart and GaugeChart. of(String, ChartType, Object) sends data of any shape for a ChartType, for charts the classes do not cover; the report viewer shows the data as sent when it cannot draw it.
